resources.string: Optional one-shot assist for WhatsApp Messenger. When the user explicitly arms a message, this service checks the visible WhatsApp screen for that exact composer text and may tap Send. It does not open chats or compose messages.

Reads notification previews only from WhatsApp Messenger and WhatsApp Business to show them in GKFXL Automate. If the user separately enables WhatsApp Business auto-replies, it may reply using that notification action. Notification text is saved locally on this device.
